notes.title: Flipside Studio Update #37 - Stream directly to Zoom, Skype, etc.
notes.notes:
Please note: This update includes some big changes which we wanted to give everyone time to test out safely and adapt to their projects, so to try it out you'll need to opt into our Beta release channel. [url=https://www.flipsidexr.com/beta-signup]Instructions on switching between release channels can be found here.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32230757/8c80daa43ba30729abe4eb59b602484da9bfbf53.png[/img]

[h1]Flipside Studio[/h1]
[h2]Stream directly to Zoom, Skype, etc.[/h2]
We've added a plugin that creates a "Flipside Studio" virtual camera device in Windows, so you can select Flipside in your camera list in any video chat software, including Zoom, Skype, Slack, Whereby, etc.

To turn the virtual camera device on, press [b]Alt+D[/b] in Flipside Studio. The first time you do, Windows will popup up a notice requesting administrative permission to install the virtual camera device. Give it permission and you should see "Flipside Studio" in your camera options the next time you launch your video chat software of choice.

[i]Note: If you don't see "Flipside Studio" in your camera options, you may need to restart Windows for the change to take effect.[/i]

Also note that you will need to press [b]Alt+D[/b] to enable the virtual camera each time you run Flipside Studio while this feature is still considered experimental and not enabled by default.

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*] Added a [b]Re-Sync[/b] button under the [b]Recordings[/b] palette menu which does a complete re-sync of your multiplayer session should things fall out of sync for any reason.
[*] Improved default microphone selection logic when multiple microphone devices are available.
[*] Improved audio playback performance.
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2][list]
[*] Fixed voices going out of sync on added parts.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused eye rotations to go in the wrong direction.
[*] Fixed a bug causing sets to fail to load if they share the same bundle name as the previously loaded set.
[*] Fixed a bug in how character bundle version numbers are compared.
[/list]
[h1]Flipside Creator Tools[/h1]
[url=https://www.flipsidexr.com/docs/1.0/creator-tools/installation-and-setup]Click here[/url] to download the latest version of the Flipside Creator Tools beta (v0.33).

[h2]Duplicate characters and sets[/h2]
Duplicating the scene file for a character or set can lead to issues building bundles because Unity gets confused when more than one scene file has the same asset bundle label.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32230757/2a060dc06736f100979fb4e6a696f2ca68cbc019.png[/img]

To make this less error-prone, we've added a new [b]Duplicate Selected Scene[/b] menu option under the Flipside Creator Tools menu which duplicates the scene and also changes the asset bundle label at the same time, making it easy now to create alternate versions of characters and sets for testing.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2][list]
[*] Fixed an orientation issue with the VR teleporter. It now behaves more consistently like Flipside Studio's teleporter.
[*] Fixed a case where the Chair component wouldn't initialize properly for some users.
[*] Fixed CC3 character importing to correctly map blend shapes based on names.
[/list]

notes.title: Flipside Studio Update #36 - Auto-scrolling teleprompter, update saved setups
notes.notes:
Please note: This update includes some big changes which we wanted to give everyone time to test out safely and adapt to their projects, so to try it out you'll need to opt into our [b]Beta[/b] release channel. [url=https://www.flipsidexr.com/beta-signup]Instructions on switching between release channels can be found here.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32230757/6c875b8fa8cfc525481987adf7458f17388262f0.png[/img]

[h2]Flipside Studio[/h2]
[h3]Auto-scrolling teleprompter[/h3]
We've revamped our teleprompter controller to support auto-scrolling with an adjustable speed slider. You can play, pause, rewind, fast-forward, or advance one screen of text at a time.

[h3]Saved setups are now editable[/h3]
Last update we added the ability to delete your saved setups. This update adds the ability to update them as well, so you can now dress your sets exactly how you want them, save your setup, then come back and make further refinements at a later time.

[h3]Other improvements[/h3][list]
[*] Improved finger positioning when grabbing props with physics hands.
[*] Added Unity's constraint components to the list of supported component you can use in custom characters and sets.
[*] Further improvements to the expressiveness of lip syncing.
[*] Improved error handling and reporting during initial load as well as character and set loading.
[*] Your controllers now stay visible at all times instead of showing only when the user interface is visible.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed lighting issues going from sets with lightprobes to sets without lightprobes.
[*] Prevented getting fingers into strange hold positions grabbing props with physics characters.
[*] Fixed camera switcher not scaling with you in ghost mode.
[*] Eye rotation fixes on additional characters.
[*] Keep the "Press Esc to exit fullscreen" overlaytext hidden if any 3rd party capturing software is open (list includes: OBS, Streamlabs OBS, Xsplit, Twitch Studio, Mixer, Caffeine, VLC, Camtasia Studio, Bandicam, LIV Client, Mixcast).
[/list]
[h2]Flipside Creator Tools[/h2]
[h3]Improvements[/h3][list]
[*] Added resting position threshold to the Blink All setting on AvatarModelReferences to make the natural eyelid resting position customizable.
[*] Added Unity's constraint components to the list of supported component you can use in custom characters and sets.
[*] Initial support for auto-setup of imported characters from Character Creator.
[*] Added a Resource Usage panel in the Inspector window for AvatarModelReferences and SetInfo components, giving visibility into the resources that your assets are using. The panel also includes recommended maximums for each resource for both PC and mobile. The mobile numbers are the current numbers we're targeting for Flipside Studio on Oculus Quest (still in closed beta testing).
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed FlipsideActions.OnHide events not firing correctly.
[*] TargetElement now works even if there's no ScoreboardElement in the scene.
[*] Calls to FlipsideActions.ChangeSky(id) now change the skybox while testing in the Unity editor.
[/list]

notes.title: Flipside Studio Update #35 - Eye realism, improved texture-based faces, and more
notes.notes:
Please note: This update includes some big changes which we wanted to give everyone time to test out safely and adapt to their projects, so to try it out you'll need to opt into our [b]Beta[/b] release channel. [url=https://www.flipsidexr.com/beta-signup]Instructions on switching between release channels can be found here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32230757/eb4b5d4e4d8554650e70e9314c59e5cae8e20aca.png[/img]

[h3]More realistic eyes[/h3]

Eye movement has been improved in the following ways:

[list]
[*] We've improved the range of motion to feel more natural when looking at eye targets like other characters or the handheld camera.
[*] We've added procedural animation when not looking at eye targets that mimics focusing on different points of interest. We keep the gaze on a point within a small range of head movement to add more realism, so eyes don't feel so locked to head movement.
[*] We've made blinking feel more natural too.
[/list]

[h3]Camera switcher now found under Set Builder > Show Tools[/h3]

We've moved the VR camera switcher to the [b]Set Builder[/b] menu under [b]Show Tools[/b]. This also means you can have as many VR camera switchers as you want!

This means that the desktop camera switcher going fullscreen doesn't open the VR camera switcher any more. Instead, it works totally independently. Press [b]Alt+F[/b] to go fullscreen, and press [b]Esc[/b] to exit fullscreen.

You'll see the instructions [i]"Press Esc to exit fullscreen"[/i] appear on your monitor when you move your mouse, but it only shows up with a deliberate move of the mouse so it won't pop up if you accidentally bump your desk while in VR.

[h3]Other Flipside Studio improvements[/h3]

[list]
[*] Pointing no longer sticks with trigger presses on SteamVR, instead it points while you have the index finger trigger pressed and stops pointing when you stop pressing.
[*] Improved the feel of texture-based facial animations by holding each expression for a minimum number of frames.
[*] When you connect Flipside Studio to [url=https://obsproject.com/]OBS[/url], your OBS "Mic/Aux" sync offset is set automatically to ensure audio is in time with lip syncing.
[*] Added a [b]Delete Setup[/b] button to be able to delete previously saved setups.
[*] Added the [url=https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/tools/particles-effects/trails-fx-146898]Trails FX[/url] Unity plugin to the list of supported components.
[/list]

[h3]Flipside Creator Tools improvements[/h3]

[list]
[*] Auto-hide overlay text in the Flipside Creator Tools unless you move your cursor over the Game window.
[*] Added a button to the [b]SetInfo[/b] component to apply the Flipside skybox to the current scene outside of play mode.
[*] Added buttons to [b]SetInfo[/b] to copy lighting settings between [b]SetInfo[/b] and the Lighting window.
[*] Added a gizmo in the Scene window that shows where your Center Eye is located.
[/list]

The latest version of the Flipside Creator Tools (v0.31) can be [url=https://www.flipsidexr.com/docs/1.0/creator-tools/installation-and-setup]downloaded here[/url].

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the Combo Textures facial expressions having the open/closed mouth textures backwards.
[*] Fixed an issue with Textures lip syncing being affected by facial expressions and blinking.
[*] Fixed [b]TwitchActions[/b] to trigger events for everyone in the multiplayer session, not just the Twitch streamer.
[*] Fixed one cause of characters with body physics to end up in contorted positions.
[*] Fixed a cause of Twitch chat messages not appearing on the panel.
[*] Fixed menu never stopping if your play area is too small.
[*] Fixed multiple [b]GunElement[/b] components all sharing the same bullet pool.
[*] Fixed [b]GunElement[/b] occasionally not firing.
[/list]

notes.title: Flipside Studio Update #20 - Flipside goes MULTIPLAYER!!!!!
notes.notes:
[b]NOTE: This update is an experimental release. In order to use it, you will need to opt into our Beta channel. To do so, right click Flipside Studio in your library and choose Properties, then opt in under the Betas tab. No access code is needed.[/b]

[h1]Make shows together, the way it should be[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/313acfa2f0d1d200bebbbd874a55a70cf2ee6cbb.png[/img]

When you press the Friends button on the palette, you'll see our new Friends & Notifications panel appear.

This is the new social hub in Flipside, where you can find your friends, invite them to collaborate, and find notifications for things like friend requests, invites, and also the occasional Flipside announcement.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/d3ec5c7ac6a090a8cf6e403e96329eb6d5acb3f6.jpg[/img]

Multiplayer works across platforms, so it doesn't matter if your friends are using an HTC Vive and you're using an Oculus Rift. You can still hop in, connect, and create content together over distance.

This update also has some major improvements to the Flipside Creator Tools plugin for Unity and a number of bug fixes. For all the details, visit:

https://www.flipsidexr.com/blog/post/56/flipside-studio-update-20-flipside-goes-multiplayer

notes.notes:
We've got a new Flipside update for y'all! This one includes a massive update to the Flipside Creator Tools too!

notes.title: Flipside Alpha Update #15 - New characters, vlogger set, and loads of improvements
notes.notes:
[h1]Two new characters![/h1]

Meet the new [b]Crocodile [/b]and [b]Lion[/b] characters. Along with our existing Elephant and Giraffe characters, these two round out our jungle characters collection nicely.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/b0150b7afb9f63464c565ae68c845984f0652f19.png[/img]

[h1]A new vlogger set![/h1]

We've added a [b]Vlogger Living Room[/b] set you can use to quickly make vlog-style recordings. This set is already setup with cameras and everything so you can jump right in and get creating.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/6972cd6db6d7eb68d0eb35a29850c65ea1221b8f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Finger pointing for HTC Vive users[/h1]

HTC Vive users can now press the index finger trigger to switch between open hand and pointing hand poses, making button pressing easier and adding more expressiveness to hands.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/7e0eddd399b1e61d3a48b1a20061d845e757d6d6.png[/img]

[h1]Clock prop to see the time[/h1]

When you're in VR for long you can easily lose track of time. Our new clock prop will help you keep track of time back in the real world.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/fe245409af1210010b94f38d4f50f924a62103e1.png[/img]

[h1]Resize your preview monitors[/h1]

We've added the ability to scale preview monitors just like you can with ordinary props. Just grab a monitor with two hands and make it any size you want.

[h1]Bug fixes and other smaller improvements[/h1]

We've also made loads of small fixes and quality of life improvements throughout the app:

[list][*]Auto-hide mouse cursor when it's not moving, so that pesky mouse cursor never ruins a shot again[/*][*]No more jarring perspective change when entering Set Builder mode[/*][*]Flipside will automatically launch OBS Studio if you try to connect before it's running[/*][*]Custom characters no longer require finger or shoulder bones to import properly[/*][*]Fixed visual glitches in our 2D output when changing sets[/*][*]Silenced user interface sounds when recording video or live streaming[/*][/list]

notes.title: Flipside Alpha Update #14 - Improved lip sync accuracy, camera zoom, and loads of fixes!
notes.notes:
Hey there Flipsters!

Here's another update we think you're going to love, so let's jump right in!

[h1]Much improved lip sync timing![/h1]

We spent a ton of time honing our lip syncing and we're finally ready to unleash the results of those efforts. With some clever hacking, Flipside's lip sync responsiveness is now more than double what it was in previous releases!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Swb1ffUkuik

This is a huge leap forward for improving the quality of Flipside's output and will make a noticeable difference for everyone.

[h1]Use the joystick/thumbpad to zoom on the handheld camera[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/3afcbadd22ac86321326ec5e15f55d93b402781d.jpg[/img]

This is another feature that's been requested several times, and it makes a big difference in using the handheld camera. Just press up/forward to zoom in or down/backward to zoom out. It feels very natural to use.

[h1]Other bug fixes and improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*]Remember if you're in fullscreen mode on next launch[/*]
[*]Improved hand positioning so it's easier to press Stop Recording on Vive[/*]
[*]Fixed preview cameras rendering too soon and showing inaccurate previews[/*]
[*]Fixed Play button on in-VR camera switcher not switching to Stop button[/*]
[*]Fixed character scale differences on the characters palette[/*]
[/list]

Thanks again to all our users. We're working hard to bring a level of polish to everything in Flipside in order to make your productions faster, smoother, and better.

Every week we say this, but we're still just getting started. There's so much coming in time that Flipside is only going to get better and better until it's just the most natural way to create animations, period. So thanks for coming on this journey with us!

The Flipside Team

notes.title: Flipside Alpha Update #13 - In-VR camera switching, dynamic light, new character and more
notes.notes:
This update is one that many of you have been waiting for! We have some great bug fixes, a new character, and best of all — an in-VR camera controller!!!

[h1]In-VR camera switcher[/h1]
The feature that so many of you have requested is finally here! We now have a camera switcher that lets you control your camera moves and settings in VR. We'll be polishing it up as we go, but figured best to get it in your hands as soon as possible. To access the in-VR camera switcher, press [b]Alt + S[/b] on your keyboard.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/b4d2f3f56f605e72526781b0561936de45d9cd72.png[/img]

[h1]Fullscreen mode[/h1]
This mode works hand-in-hand with the in-VR camera switcher. To hide the camera switcher interface that appears on your computer screen, press [b]Alt + S[/b]. This will let you record full screen output through OBS and will pop up your in-VR camera switcher.

[h1]Meet Bones[/h1]
We've had this character in the hopper for a while now and figure it's just about time we introduced you to bones, the skeleton version of our first dinosaur character!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/c205499093581611e33d3d273acdc2431ec23c16.png[/img]

[h1]Dynamic lights[/h1]
We've added a new dynamic light prop to the set builder, which you can find under the Show Tools category. The dynamic light lets you place and control your own lighting on any set, and you can even grab them to modify your lighting during your shows!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/e544a7a1cb071f64a359c030021863222dbcadd7.png[/img]

notes.title: Flipside Alpha Update #9
notes.notes:
Continuing our focus on bug fixes from last week's update, we've made lots of little improvements again this week too. But we also have one new feature we're excited to share:

[h1]Sky's the limit[/h1]

You can now upload your own 360 photos to change the skies in Flipside! Combined with our blank set, this means you can use any 360 photo as a custom environment for your shows.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/9f435f7097429a03cfc1136b5448f4cf21ea51da.png[/img]

Flipside supports both mono and stereoscopic 360 photos in either PNG or JPG format. Stereo photos must be in "over/under" mode (left eye on top, right eye on bottom).

This opens up a world of new show possibilities, and is step one on our way to completely custom set importing. We can't wait to see [u]where[/u] you guys take Flipside next!

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

Here's what we managed to improve for you guys since last week:

[list]
[*]Improved keyboard controls for camera editing: Pressing 1, 2, 3 now respects the current latch setting (cut or move), but you can override the latch via C+1 or M+1 combos to specify a deliberate cut or move.[/*]
[*]Imported props now support a much wider number of material settings, so your props should be looking better than ever.[/*]
[*]We made more fixes to the slideshow, which now supports loads of video formats, as well as photos, YouTube links, Dropbox links, and live streams over RTSP and RTMP.[/*]
[*]Lots of smaller behind-the-scenes fixes.[/*]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/0c53a38375d06428e7ea435f51dc1a00db59883c.png[/img]

We're moving fast, and we have lots more coming up too that we can't wait to share with our amazing creator community. Make sure you share your creations on our [url=https://discord.gg/q3n9ppA]Discord chat[/url], our [url=https://www.flipsidexr.com/community]community forum[/url], or using the hashtag [url=https://twitter.com/hashtag/MadeinFlipside]#madeinflipside[/url] on Twitter.

notes.title: Flipside Alpha Update #8
notes.notes:
This week's update is focused on bringing you bug fixes and quality of life improvements.

[h1]Slideshow supports YouTube videos[/h1]

We've made a big upgrade to the slideshow video playback, and now you can link to YouTube videos, and a wider list of video formats are supported now too.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/5908862e5f3904761c66b2b7290ba274ab933fdd.jpg[/img]
[u]That's our Flipside Studio trailer, playing in Flipside via YouTube![/u]

[h1]Hands, touching hands, reaching ooout...[/h1]

In the last few releases, your real hands and your character's hands weren't completely aligned. This caused noticeable issues when interacting with props that feel like they're not quite in your hand. We're happy to say we've solved this by adding a little stretchiness to the arms, which works more closely to how our arm system worked in the past.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/bfa4cf5c16b13754ad95ff79a1a7bf47cb11573e.jpg[/img]

For characters with really long arms, we've also found that you can run your body calibration sitting down and without fully extending your arms. Then you can act that part while sitting, and your arms will stretch to feel more natural for your character. This is one of the techniques actors use when embodying puppets that don't match their own dimensions, and it's pretty fun too!

[h1]Holding props while recording starts[/h1]

There was a bug that caused props that were being held at the start of a recording to be reset to their original positions on the set. That's been fixed, and now you can grab a prop and have it ready in hand when recording starts.

[h1]Twitter photo sharing[/h1]

Photos weren't showing up in Twitter photo shares, but that's now been fixed. [u]Share on, Wayne![/u]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/d7609f85459fcba311811f3fb5ee3606b4381051.png[/img]

[h1]Misc fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]We've added more error checking to prevent the disappearing menu bug.[/*]
[*]We've fixed how characters scale, so now you can adjust their size in the Creator Tools and Flipside will apply the correct scale to your characters. [u][b]Note: Make sure you update to version 0.8 of the [url=https://www.flipsidexr.com/docs/1.0/creator-tools]Flipside Creator Tools[/url].[/b][/u][/*]
[*]Playback and physics are now paused when you open the Steam menu or Oculus Dash.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Flipside Alpha Update #7
notes.notes:
It's time for another Flipside Studio update!

[h1]Discord chat server[/h1]

First, we've added a [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/q3n9ppA]Discord chat server[/url] to our list of ways you can reach us for help, as well as meet other creators in the Flipside Creator Community. We're also active on our Steam Discussion page so feel free to reach out in whatever way work best for you!

[h1]Mixed Reality filming in Flipside (preview)[/h1]

Flipside Studio now supports [url=http://www.kertgartner.com/making-mixed-reality-vr-trailers-and-videos/]Mixed Reality filming[/url] via an HTC Vive Tracker attached to a real-world camera. The coolest part is that it also works with our existing Vive Tracker support for tracking your lower body! The second coolest part is that you can still switch back and forth between Mixed Reality and any other cameras you have on your set, without exiting Mixed Reality mode.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/197603d3de544c54ee9685055c78e70295553f5f.png[/img]

We're calling this a feature preview since it's a big change and may have introduced new bugs we didn't catch yet. And of course, you can find the complete info on using Flipside's new [url=https://www.flipsidexr.com/docs/1.0/recording-a-show/mixed-reality-mode]Mixed Reality mode in our documentation.[/url]

Special thanks to [url=http://www.raktor.org/]Raktor[/url] and [url=https://liv.tv/]LIV[/url] for their help in getting this feature built.

[h1]Viking props[/h1]

Vikings are cool. Because vikings are so cool, we've started adding viking-related things into Flipside, starting with some new viking props. More viking-related things will follow.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/98cedc57224eb1c6dede27ca5bde083532d43420.png[/img]
[i]Why yes, you may see my battle axe. Would you care for another flagon of ale?[/i]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

1. We fixed an issue that caused Flipside Studio to fail to load in some cases. Apologies to everyone that was affected by this bug!

2. Oculus Touch controllers now work the same through SteamVR as they do through Oculus Home, including the ability to control the slideshow and teleprompter in VR (HTC Vive users will be able to do this soon too, we promise!).

3. Camera previews in the Set Builder now show a 1:1 preview of the real camera output, so now you have an accurate reference when setting up your cameras.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/a75c4de012d5e3d09690bf42fa165eaba8ff376c.png[/img]

4. We've made a big improvement to the feel and accuracy of throwing props away in the Set Builder. For reference, you can delete objects by throwing them over your shoulder or with the Delete button in the Prop Settings panel.

5. We've added a scale reference and automatic fixes for scale when your imported character is way too small or too large. [url=https://www.flipsidexr.com/docs/1.0/creator-tools]Click here to go download the latest version[/url] of the Flipside Creator Tools. A big thanks to [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/BrunoPatto]Bruno Pato[/url] for working through these issues with us!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/8067dcfdd5cf4a1288f6e9430a890c0a447aed25.png[/img]

That's it for this week. Stay tuned, we've got tons more exciting things to share in the coming weeks!

notes.title: Flipside Alpha Update #6
notes.notes:
Flipside update time! This week we have a small update with some really cool things for you.

[h1]Stickman characters[/h1]

We've added two stickman-style characters for you to play with. Making your own stickman shows in Flipside is ridiculous fun!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32230757/dcf27ca036172c9e5a0ee3482534dfa15fd3f247.jpg[/img]

[h1]Character importer movement previews[/h1]

Last week we showed you that you could press Play in the Unity editor to preview your characters in VR before importing them into Flipside. Now when you press A/X on Oculus Touch, the Application Menu buttons on HTC Vive, or hit the space bar on your keyboard, your character will do a little dance for you that shows you how your character moves from all angles, helping identify issues in your model's rigging, weighting, textures, etc.

For a video of a character dancing in the Creator Tools, see the [url=https://www.flipsidexr.com/blog/post/23/flipside-alpha-update-6]original blog post here[/url].

[h1]Character importer texture fixes[/h1]

We've also improved our texture handling, particularly for Adobe Fuse & Mixamo character importing. This should make everyone's lives a little easier importing custom characters. No extra steps, just make sure you're on the latest version of the [url=https://www.flipsidexr.com/docs/1.0/creator-tools]Flipside Creator Tools[/url].

Visit the [url=https://www.flipsidexr.com/docs/1.0/creator-tools]Creator Tools page[/url] to download the latest update (v0.6).

That's it for this week. Stay tuned, we've got tons more exciting things to share in the coming weeks!
